verdicts.reasoning: READ: DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:4956-4976 reads string(event.payload, "artifactId","id","identifier"), "kind", "title" and "version" off the RAW payload. visible() (4599-4606) only filters by kind and visibility, and the private string() helper (4548-4555) does no lifting. The cloud runner's emit (scripts/work-runner.ts:3549-3569 -> 2885-2923) stores the runtime event object verbatim, and recordArtifact emits {kind:'artifact_created', artifact} (runner/agent-core/src/work/session.ts:580-589; types.ts:534-541, 727-728). WorkEventPayload.fields (WorkEventPayload.swift:46-81) would lift 'artifact', but this reader never calls it. The iPhone twin is identical (JunoMobileWorkView.swift:2237-2257). The web reader lifts (work-detail-panels.tsx:181-201, readEvent). The Mac's own run host (DesktopWorkRunHost.swift) never emits artifact_created (its emits are at 133, 157, 168, 181, 235, 295, 302, 354-415, 543, 559), so the only real producer is the enveloped one. That means the reader never matches any real event, and only the flat preview fixture (PreviewWorkFixtures.swift:443-449) satisfies it. Nuance: the Activity timeline DOES lift (describe(), 5083-5091, 5175-5184), so the Mac and iPhone Activity show 'Created Q3 forecast' while the Made section on the same screen says 'No documents yet'. 'Never appear from the stream' therefore applies to the Made list, not to the whole screen. The iPhone Made section has no other source (JunoMobileWorkView.swift:913-947).

READ: the only callers of refreshOpenArtifacts are loadOpenSession (NativeWorkModel.swift:1038) and the error-row Retry (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3113). git grep finds no others in native/. loadOpenSession runs once, at the top of the follow() task (963-973). The stream loop's apply(update) (1051-1059), the .done branch (986-994), reconnects and refresh() (450-473) never re-read artifacts. open() returns early for the same session while streamTask is non-nil (617). The .done path returns without nil-ing streamTask, so re-clicking the same finished task does nothing. Recovery needs a different selection: Overview calls closeOpenSession (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:587-593), or selecting another task and coming back works too. The web refetches on produced-count change (work-documents.tsx:98-101). Combined with parity-1, a watched cloud run's deliverable does not reach Made until the task is reopened.

READ: the createSession body (NativeWorkClient.swift:361-405) has no conversationId or projectId, and WorkSessionSummary has no conversation field (WorkContracts.swift:169-195). createWorkSessionForUser only validates a supplied conversationId and stores conversationId ?? null (src/lib/work/dispatch.ts:356, 412-417, 555); it never creates a conversation. workRecentHref returns null when there is no conversation (src/lib/work/recents.ts:173-179). /work/<id> redirects to chatPathForSession(null) = '/chat' ('src/app/(app)/work/[[...segments]]/page.tsx' final line; src/lib/work-url-migration.ts:185-187). Search hits use the same href (src/lib/search/engine.ts:489, 509). The only web consumers of the sessions list are conversation-keyed (app-sidebar via use-needs-you-count byConversation) plus the project page, and native creates no projectId either. prisma.workArtifact is read only by /api/work/artifacts routes, so no web library lists WorkArtifacts. iOS has no download code (git grep downloadArtifact in native/iOS is empty).

READ: git grep WorkDocuments finds only its definition (work-documents.tsx:111), with no importers in src or tests. work-run-panel.tsx imports only WorkDeliverableStage for deliverables (14, 357). The stage filters to canPreviewArtifact (site/report/spreadsheet, work-site-preview.tsx:164-166), picks the newest one (work-deliverable-stage.tsx:33-39) and returns null otherwise (43). It prints 'N more files under Outputs.' (74-77), and no Outputs rail exists in the chat panel. WorkOutcomeDigest and the timeline helpers imported by the panel have no download links. A run producing only docx or pdf therefore gets no web download surface in chat.

READ: load() uses try decodeVersion / try decodeArtifact per record (NativeArtifactStore.swift:101-103, 111-113). decodeVersion throws on content.utf16.count > 200_000 (157-159) and decodeArtifact throws on an unknown type (144-147). NativeArtifactStoreTests.swift:78 pins this fail-closed behaviour on purpose. reload() catch sets phase .failed and leaves `artifacts` untouched (283-287). On a cold start, which is every launch once the bad row is in the encrypted local DB, the list is empty. Mid-session, the last good list stays frozen because every later reload throws. Server paths over the limit are real: DESIGN is length-checked pre-expansion (chat-artifact-verification.ts:61-70, 86-99) and stored post-expansion (artifacts-store.ts:16-25, 46) with no re-check, and route.ts:3592 calls persistArtifacts(parseArtifacts(audit.report)) without verification. The PUT route caps at 200_000 (src/app/api/artifacts/[id]/route.ts:8). CORRECTION: the Mac Design launcher does not show 'Artifacts unavailable'. It filters model.artifacts (DesktopDesignScreen.swift:229-231) and shows 'No designs yet' (373-378), which is misleading (see missed). The iPhone shows its failure view only when artifacts is empty (JunoMobileWorkspaceViews.swift:779). INFER: whether an oversized row exists in production is unverified. The new-type path is exactly what a Claude-style DOC/SLIDES merge would add, and older installed builds would blank.

READ with od -c: line 3142 is `CharacterSet(charactersIn: "/\\:\\0")`. The bytes are / \ \ : \ \ 0, so the Swift string is '/', '\', ':', '\', '0' and the set is {/, \, :, 0}; NUL is not in it. Titles are split on this set and joined with '-' (3143-3146), and the result is passed as nameFieldStringValue (3447) for both the validated and unvalidated paths (3122-3129, 2528-2529). Every '0' in a title becomes '-'.

READ: plan(from:) reads event.payload["steps"] raw (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:4665-4666), and references reads url/title raw for sourceCited (4851-4853). The iPhone twin does the same (JunoMobileWorkView.swift:2028-2029, 2138-2140). Cloud plan events are {kind, plan:{version, steps}} (types.ts:385-388, 692-693; session.ts:601, 639) and citations sit under `citation` (session.ts:592-595). The doc comment at 4712-4715 claims every reader lifts, which is false. UPGRADE: the claim understates the scope. No native executor emits a flat plan: DesktopWorkRunHost emits no plan_created or source_cited at all. So the Plan section is empty for EVERY real run, not just cloud runs. plan_created/plan_updated are also excluded from the Activity timeline as 'renderedElsewhere' (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:5015-5019; iPhone 2289-2293), so the plan appears nowhere on Mac or iPhone. The Overview tab, the default surface, always shows the 'hasn't written a plan' copy (2957-2961).

READ: loadArtifactDetail and downloadArtifact both write the shared artifactErrorDescription (NativeWorkModel.swift:714-719, 742-749). Retry calls refreshOpenArtifacts (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3112-3114), which clears the error on success (NativeWorkModel.swift:692-693) without retrying the failed operation. With detail == nil the expanded row shows the spinner 'Reading version history…' (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3425-3430) until it is collapsed and re-expanded (the expand closure reloads only on expand, 3062-3069). Severity lowered: the error text is visible until Retry is pressed and Save can simply be pressed again, so this is misleading recovery, not data loss.
READ: DesktopWorkArtifactSavePanel.save catches the bytes.write error and returns nil (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3450-3456). saveArtifact treats nil as a cancel (3131-3136). No error surface exists.

READ: artifactDownloadID is one optional (NativeWorkModel.swift:50), set and cleared with defer (733-734). Each row disables only its own Save (isDownloading = artifactDownloadID == artifact.artifactID, DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3060, 3363, 3416), so a second row can start a download concurrently. The first completion's defer then nils the flag while the second is still in flight.

READ: the artifact_version sync loader serialises id, artifactId, version, content and createdAt only (src/lib/sync-entities.ts:244-259), though ArtifactVersion.origin exists (prisma/schema.prisma ArtifactVersion model). decodeVersion sets origin: nil (NativeArtifactStore.swift:160-167). openArtifact merges REST versions that carry origins (290-313, 433-445), but synchronizationDidAdvance -> reload replaces `artifacts` wholesale (252-265), and it fires from JunoDesktopRootView.swift:74-82. The origin labels at DesktopArtifactsScreen.swift:854-855 and 1089-1090 then disappear.

READ: contracts/openapi/juno-native-v1.yaml:1866-1868 enum is [HTML, REACT, CODE, MARKDOWN, SVG, MERMAID], referenced at 1885 and 1917. Prisma ArtifactType includes DESIGN and native NativeArtifactKind includes design (NativeArtifactAPIClient.swift:13-22). tests/native-contract.test.ts has no ArtifactKind/ArtifactType/DESIGN reference, and the Swift generator does not emit ArtifactKind (it is hand-written). The impact is documentation and contract drift only, because no generated client consumes it.

READ: segments are Overview, Context, Activity, Files & cost (2367-2381), so Files & cost is the FOURTH segment, not the third. The surface resets to .overview on session change (2516-2518). The .files surface renders changes, then artifacts, then budget (2662-2665). Overview is currentAction + plan (2656-2658), and per parity-7 the plan is always empty. The web stage renders the deliverable inline in the chat run panel (work-run-panel.tsx:356-358). It sits below the digest and the run's words, not literally at the top, but the Cowork-style arrangement point stands.

READ: DesktopWorkArtifactRow (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3315-3440) offers only Save and History. git grep for QuickLook/QLPreview/preview in DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift and JunoWorkKit is empty, so no preview endpoint is called. After saving, the file is revealed in Finder (3135), where Quick Look is outside Juno. The web previews site/report/spreadsheet inline (work-site-preview.tsx:164-166; work-deliverable-stage.tsx:68-73).

READ: the Mac empty state renders when both produced and durable are empty (DesktopWorkWorkspace.swift:3045-3053). The iPhone renders it whenever event-derived produced is empty (JunoMobileWorkView.swift:915-919). The event-derived list never matches real events (parity-1), and the Mac's durable list is read once per open (parity-2). Scope: on Mac the false empty state affects tasks watched live (or opened before their first deliverable) until reopened, since a finished task opened fresh gets the durable list. On iPhone it affects every run, and the same screen's Activity timeline says 'Created …' at the same time.

Same evidence as mac-work-parity-4: the stage renders only previewable kinds, returns null otherwise (work-deliverable-stage.tsx:33-43) and points to a non-existent 'Outputs' (74-77). WorkDocuments, which had Download and per-version history, is unused.

READ: Try Again / Retry call model.reload() (DesktopArtifactsScreen.swift:728-736; JunoMobileWorkspaceViews.swift:787), which re-reads the same local snapshot and throws again (NativeArtifactStore.swift:89-135). CORRECTION: the Mac Design launcher shows no 'unavailable' state. It shows 'No designs yet' (DesktopDesignScreen.swift:373-378), and starting a design reports 'It will appear here as soon as this Mac finishes syncing' because the post-create reload fails (557-566). The iPhone shows the failure only when artifacts is empty (779). Mid-session the old list stays but is frozen.

READ: WorkSessionSummary carries no conversation id (WorkContracts.swift:169-195). git grep in native/ for start_task, workHandoff or conversation-linked work finds nothing. DesktopChatWorkspace passes workModel to DesktopChatSidebar (168), where it is declared (DesktopChatSidebar.swift:20) and never used. The web finds a chat's task by polling ?conversationId= (use-conversation-work.ts:38-75), and the Mac has no equivalent. INFER: the Mac chat transcript shows only the persisted assistant text for such a turn, and the task appears only in the separate Work product with no link back.

missed.title: Mac Design launcher reports 'No designs yet' and a false 'will appear after sync' when the artifact store fails to load
missed.evidence: READ: designs = model.artifacts.filter{isDesignDocument} (229-231). launcherContent shows JunoEmptyState('No designs yet', …) whenever designs is empty (373-378) and never consults model.phase or lastErrorDescription. start(_:) creates the design server-side, then calls model.reload(). If the store throws (NativeArtifactStore.swift:157, 144), the id is missing and the launcher says 'Juno started the design. It will appear here as soon as this Mac finishes syncing.' (557-566).
missed.failure_scenario: One oversized or unknown-type artifact row is in the local DB. The Design page says the user has no designs. Each preset click creates another server-side design and promises it will appear after sync, which never happens, so the user piles up invisible 'Untitled design' rows.

missed.title: Web chat deliverable stage never refetches when an existing deliverable gets a new version
missed.evidence: READ: documents = useWorkArtifactList(sessionId, artifacts.length, run !== null). artifacts = deriveArtifacts(events) (233), which keys by id so artifact_updated replaces rather than adds (work-detail-panels.tsx:181-201). useWorkArtifactList refetches only when `produced` changes (work-documents.tsx:98-101), and nothing calls documents.reload in src/components/chat or work/detail. The stage renders v{currentVersion} and previews version={artifact.currentVersion} (work-deliverable-stage.tsx:53, 68-73).
missed.failure_scenario: A run writes report v1, then revises it to v2 (artifact_updated). The chat stage keeps showing 'v1' and previewing the v1 body, and Download fetches the latest while the preview shows the old text, until the page is reloaded.

missed.title: Plan events are hidden from the Mac/iPhone Activity timeline while the Plan section can never render them
missed.evidence: READ: renderedElsewhere = [.planCreated, .planUpdated] filters plan events out of entries(in:) (5015-5019; iPhone JunoMobileWorkView.swift:2289-2293) on the premise that the Plan section shows them. plan(from:) reads raw payload['steps'] (4666), and the only executor that emits plan events is the cloud runner with a {plan:{…}} envelope (session.ts:601, 639). DesktopWorkRunHost emits no plan events.
missed.failure_scenario: For every run, the plan is shown nowhere on Mac or iPhone: not in Overview (empty-state copy) and not in Activity (filtered). Only the individual step_started rows appear. Fixing the timeline filter alone would not help; plan(from:) must read WorkEventPayload.fields(of:).
